# `log`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the logarithm of `expr` with `base`.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
log(base, expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `math_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- log, example 1
> SELECT log(10, 100);
2.0
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.5.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
